title: The Mossy Bridge
text: A stone bridge is so overgrown it looks like a hill with a hole in it. A sign hangs from it, painted in something dark: TOLL. Beneath the arch a troll the size of a cottage snores, a purse rising and falling on its belly.

options.label: Creep across past the sleeping troll without waking it.

outcomes.text: The troll snores on as you cross. On the far side its toll box sits unattended.
It wakes, very cross about the toll.

options.label: Leave the toll on its belly, as an honest traveller would.

outcomes.text: The wood seems to approve of honesty; the path feels lighter after.

options.label: The quietest hands lift the troll's purse as it snores.

outcomes.text: The purse is fat with other travellers' tolls, and the troll never stirs.
A troll's hand closes on them. Something gives way with a crunch.

options.label: The Knight wakes the troll and pays the toll to its face, as honour demands.

outcomes.text: The troll is so astonished it gives the coin back. It tells everyone it meets about the honest knight.
